title: Conditional κ ≈ 7.037017435 × 10⁻⁴ > 2⁻¹¹: five-stage bit and complex suppliers
body:
This source-bound five-stage composition gives the conditional integer-multiplication bound T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1−κ)), with

**κ = 703701743496697/10^18 = 0.000703701743496697 > 2⁻¹¹.**

It combines a new F₂ bit construction with Sussman's published five-stage complex baseline. The bit side binds.

| Paid quantity, per cover vertex | F₂ bit | Complex |
|---|---:|---:|
| Dimension m | 120 | 110 |
| Live stock W | 23,683 | 14,692 |
| Positive-rank calls | 495,304 | 361,405 |
| Rank mass | 2,837,560 | 1,613,040 |
| Deficit mW − rank mass | 4,400 | 3,080 |
| Largest child | 100 | 46 |
| Paid-moment root, approximately | 0.000704197288591 | 0.000747454944652 |

The bit source is pinned to PR210 at df95878. For comparison, PR210's newer [c4c21244](https://github.com/eumemic/integer-mult-bounds/commit/c4c21244202a8f7538dae4a859cabcd1084a98cd) reports κ = 0.0006956735022133; the assembled κ here is approximately 1.154% higher. That newer head is not incorporated here; all 57 of its verification checks passed at the comparison check on 9 October.

Each independent bit helper crosses five disjoint address windows before one paid exterior completion at five times its entrance rank. All 2,279 completions and 120 copied-center calls remain charged. Source ownership, full forward/inverse words and rational partial-swap identities bind the construction to the actual helper. The rank-100 children require four recursion levels to halve the width.

The fresh source-to-certificate verifier passes all six mandatory stages: all 20,163 bit columns in both directions, physical chronology and copied-center lifetimes, 26,380 exact basis determinants, the complex scalar/label splice, finite accounting, three ordinary-bootstrap steps and all 47 strict outer constraints. Inputs remain unchanged.

Run the complete verifier:

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-source-bound-v8/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/five-stage-source-bound-v8/verify.py --output /tmp/five-stage-v8-verification
```

The result retains the symbolic complex correctness, weighted compiler, complete-stream copying, restored-row, prime-supply, routing, precision/recovery, ordinary-leaf and all-size analytic hypotheses. No new Lean kernel build or practical multiplication benchmark is claimed.

## Approaches tested

- Completing helpers after every invocation gives a bit moment root near 0.000665572. Bundling each helper's five windows retains the paid corrections and improves that root to 0.000704197.
- The old fixed integer endpoint is unnecessarily restrictive; this construction proves its F₂ endpoint and bounds its own signed integer lift.
- The current four-bank/common-anchor interface with rank-one cross-bank shears needs five helper calls. A paid four-call workaround reaches only about 0.000305. Tested cross-port variants give relabelings or costly corrections; the tested three-bank model has an optimistic six-call root near 0.000524.

These are supplier moment results, not final multiplication exponents or global impossibility claims. Different helper actions and boundary geometry remain open.
